credit: Only complete static String Core to versioned private bytes and independent cold admission. Old --emit-bytecode/--emit-nullable-candidate String refusals and all existing flags retain behavior. No packet instruction execution, new Source/VM/Host, formal wire9, GC/ABI/RF or existing cyber STOP change.

diagnostics.invalidCore: Existing String/Core parser, identity, shape, SSA, source, units and budget diagnostics preserve original ownership; this descriptor does not weaken them.

encoding.hash32: 32 raw SHA256 bytes; decode lowercase sha256:hex only for identity formula input
encoding.integers: unsigned little-endian of stated width, unaligned and without native struct padding
encoding.utf16u16: u16 unitCount then exact ordered uint16 little-endian units, including0 and any isolated/split surrogate; no UTF8 conversion, replacement, normalization, concat evaluation or interning
encoding.utf8u32: u32 byteLength then exactly that many UTF8 bytes, no terminator; metadata paths strict normalized UTF8 without NUL; function names nonempty well-formed UTF8 may contain embedded NUL and are never normalized

functionDescriptor.profile: factsVersion1 => registerCount1/instructionCount3: fuel,constant0,return0. factsVersion2 => registerCount3/instructionCount5: fuel,constant0,constant1,concat2(0,1),return2. Uniform profile across all functions. No block/function selection or hidden records.
functionDescriptor.sourceRules: nonempty start<end<=sourceUTF16Length; function declarations in original nonoverlapping source order. Fuel range equals function; return strictly inside function; literal/concat/operator relations match Core1 exactly.

fields.exact: 80+payload byteLength, exactly the complete packet size
fields.name: totalBytes

rules: Reject any other magic/version/schema; no Nullable/scalar/legacy fallback.
Every byte after80 belongs to the one payload; reject truncation, trailing data and inconsistent counts before publishing an opaque model.

identity.opaque: inputIdentity and sourceHash have no available preimages; retain and bind them by packet payload hash, never claim Source reconstruction or use them as execution authority.
identity.rule: Recompute typeId,signatureHash and every functionId with these existing StringCore formulas. Preserve embedded NUL in functionName by explicit lengths. Never import nullable candidate domains, scalar-only module projection or rewritten Core attributes.

instruction.rules: Exact arity follows opcode; every index is a function-owned existing register; source offsets are UTF16 half-open and never byte offsets. No generic operand list, extension or padding bytes.

literalBudget.concatCodeUnits: For each encoded concat, left literal codeUnits.length + right literal codeUnits.length <= limits.concatCodeUnits (32768). This is an operand-length metadata budget only; those two leaves already count once each in packageCodeUnits.
literalBudget.packageCodeUnits: Sum codeUnits.length for every encoded constant instruction in every function exactly once. Distinct encoded leaves count separately even when their unit sequences are equal. Do not count concat result units or evaluate/materialize concat.
literalBudget.safeByteBoundaries: Before consuming or reserving unit storage, require count<=remainingBytes/2; then count*2 cannot exceed remainingBytes. Maintain cursor<=bufferLength and usedBytes<=limit before subtraction; require fieldBytes<=bufferLength-cursor and fieldBytes<=limit-usedBytes before copy/write or accumulation. Apply equivalent checked bounds before any other length multiplication or addition.
literalBudget.safeConcatLength: Require leftCount<=limits.concatCodeUnits, then rightCount<=limits.concatCodeUnits-leftCount before adding; each leaf independently remains <=limits.valueCodeUnits. No concat result allocation or second package accumulation.
literalBudget.safePackageAccumulation: Maintain used<=limits.packageCodeUnits. Before adding a leaf count, require count<=limits.valueCodeUnits and count<=limits.packageCodeUnits-used; only then used+=count. Compare before subtraction if any prior used value is untrusted.
literalBudget.source: Existing compiler/core-ir/string-verify.cpp:156-165, especially literal-storage-once rule at162-165; no existing Core profile, limit or identity change.

operations.name: constant
operations.result: exact register0, or register1 as second leaf in factsVersion2
operations.source: exact original literal range inside return, extent>=2; original ordered codeUnits unchanged

operations.name: concat
operations.semantics: opaque ordered operation only; never compute/join/normalize the literal values here
operations.source: original full concat range; same start as left literal and end as right literal. Single-unit operator between leaf ranges.

payload.functionIds: No duplicate truth table. Original tsfg_string.function_ids equals the functionId sequence of the complete records by prior Core validation; decoded function_ids is exactly this sequence. Never select or drop a function.
payload.sourceMetadata: inputIdentity and sourceHash are preserved opaque provenance; source text/facts are absent, so hashes do not confer Source authenticity. sourceUTF16Length bounds every source range.

scope: Encode complete already-verified StringCore1 modules only. No execution entry, calls, exports table, parameters, CFG, VM/AOT/Host or scalar projection; all original functions remain in declaration order.

types.rule: These private type/opcode tags have no wire9 scalar meaning. The only actual value type is original nominal String; tag1 never means i32/address.

verification: Producer validates complete original marked Core1 module via existing String verifier before measuring/encoding; original IDs/attrs/module remain unchanged.

Consumer is a separately authored opaque data model, never formal VerifiedModule/VM bytes. Verify header, full payload, all counts/identities/SSA/type/source relations and end-of-buffer before publication.
Do not grant private packet acceptance for unrepresented calls, exports, parameters, CFG/phi, other candidates, unknown fields/tags, alternate schemas or missing function records.
Zero stdout/empty out-vector on every producer failure. No partial packet/model on malformed input or budget/OOM failure.
Check byte counts before reserve/write/copy and use checked addition/multiplication for all dimensions; UTF16 unit bytes=count*2. No retries or evaluation.
